$comment: OpenGrep rule packs bundled with Pepper. Only packs whose license allows redistribution in a commercial product are bundled. See README.md.

packs.description: Pepper-authored rules: taint-based injection rules and high-confidence misconfigurations for JS/TS, Java, Kotlin, C#, Swift and iOS.
GitLab SAST rules derived from njsscan / mobsfscan: Node.js, Kotlin, Java (Android), Swift, Objective-C.

excludeRules.rules_lgpl_javascript_ssrf_rule-node-ssr: Flags every fetch/request with a variable URL (30 false positives on Pepper's own code).
excludeRules.rules_lgpl_javascript_dos_rule-regex-dos: Flags every regex.test(input); dominated WebGoat/Pepper results with no real ReDoS.
excludeRules.rules_lgpl_javascript_crypto_rule-node-i: Flags every Math.random(), including non-security ids and mocks.
excludeRules.kotlin_password_rule-HardcodePassword: Fires on JDBC URLs and non-secret strings.
excludeRules.rules_lgpl_javascript_crypto_rule-node-t: Flags any === on names like password/token (4/4 false positives on Juice Shop, e.g. password confirmation, token === null). Replaced by pepper.js.timing-unsafe-secret-compare.
